tips.label: will 後用原形
tips.text: He will sing. / He will be free. 形容詞前別漏掉 be。

tips.label: going to 前看主詞
tips.text: I am；he / she / it is；you / we / they are。going to 後接原形動詞。

tips.label: 問什麼，照句型答
tips.text: Will you...? → I will / won’t；Are you going to...? → I am / I’m not。

tips.label: 將有……
tips.text: 用 There will be 或 There is / are going to be，不能用 There will have。

tips.label: 未來安排
tips.text: We are leaving tomorrow. 現在進行式也能表達已安排的未來活動。

tips.label: 先找對應的人
tips.text: 反身代名詞依人稱與單複數變化；you two 對應 yourselves，單獨一人用 yourself。

tips.label: 自己與獨自
tips.text: She made it herself 強調她親自做；She made it by herself 強調她獨力完成。

notes.title: 未來時間與句意線索
notes.rule: tomorrow / next week / in two days / the day after tomorrow / in the future
notes.description: 這些時間詞能提示未來的事情。in two days 是「兩天後」。tomorrow、next week 前不加 on。先看上下文，再看句型；不能只憑 tomorrow 就斷定一定用 will，因為 be going to 與表示安排的現在進行式也可談未來。
examples: We will visit the castle in two days.（我們兩天後將參觀城堡。）
My uncle is arriving tomorrow morning.（我叔叔明天早上要抵達。）

notes.title: will 的肯定句
notes.rule: 主詞 + will + 原形動詞
notes.description: will 不隨主詞變化；he、she、it 後面也用 will。will 後的動詞不可加 -s、-ed 或 -ing。若後面是形容詞、名詞或地點，要補原形 be。
examples: The company will create a new game.（公司將製作一個新遊戲。）
The lesson will be interesting.（這堂課會很有趣。）

notes.title: will 的否定與縮寫
notes.rule: 主詞 + will not / won’t + 原形動詞
notes.description: will not 可縮成 won’t。I will → I’ll；you will → you’ll；he will → he’ll；she will → she’ll；we will → we’ll；they will → they’ll。否定句同樣保留原形動詞；won’t be free 的 be 不可省略。
examples: I won’t forget your help.（我不會忘記你的幫忙。）
She won’t be free tonight.（她今晚不會有空。）

notes.title: will 的問句與簡答
notes.rule:
Will + 主詞 + 原形動詞？
Yes, 主詞 + will. / No, 主詞 + won’t.
notes.description: 把 will 放到主詞前形成問句，不另外加 do / does。簡答以代名詞對應原主詞，例如 your uncle → he。肯定簡答句尾不能只寫 I’ll，要寫 I will。
examples: Will your uncle drive us home? — Yes, he will.（你叔叔會開車送我們回家嗎？會。）
Will you be late? — No, I won’t.（你會遲到嗎？不會。）

notes.title: be going to 的肯定與否定
notes.rule:
主詞 + am / is / are + going to + 原形動詞
主詞 + am / is / are + not + going to + 原形動詞
notes.description: 常用於打算、計畫，或根據眼前跡象作預測。I 用 am；he / she / it 與單數名詞用 is；you / we / they 與複數名詞用 are。going to 後用原形，形容詞前需要 be。
examples: We are going to make dinner ourselves.（我們打算自己做晚餐。）
The sky is dark. It is going to rain.（天空很暗，要下雨了。）
He isn’t going to be late.（他不會遲到。）

notes.title: be going to 的問句與簡答
notes.rule:
Am / Is / Are + 主詞 + going to + 原形動詞？
Yes, 主詞 + am / is / are. / No, 主詞 + am not / isn’t / aren’t.
notes.description: 問句以 be 開頭，標準簡答也用 be。Are you...? 回答時換成 I am / I’m not；Is she...? 則用 she is / she isn’t。注意 I am not 不能寫成 I amn’t。
examples: Are you going to buy a lamp? — Yes, I am.（你打算買檯燈嗎？是的。）
Is she going to sing? — No, she isn’t.（她打算唱歌嗎？不。）

notes.title: 疑問詞問未來的事情
notes.rule:
疑問詞 + will + 主詞 + 原形動詞？
疑問詞 + am / is / are + 主詞 + going to + 原形動詞？
notes.description: When 問時間；Where 問地點；How 問方式；What 問事情。疑問詞問句要回答相應資訊，不能只回 Yes 或 No。疑問詞後仍須保留正確的助動詞或 be 動詞位置。
examples: When will the show begin? — At seven.（表演幾點開始？七點。）
How are they going to get there? — By train.（他們打算怎麼去那裡？搭火車。）

notes.title: There 的未來式：肯定與否定
notes.rule:
There will be + 名詞.
There is / are going to be + 名詞.
There won’t be... / There isn’t / aren’t going to be...
notes.description: 表示「將有……」用 There be 句型，不能把 be 換成 have。There will be 不因後方名詞的單複數改變；There is / are going to be 則要依後方名詞決定 is 或 are。
examples: There will be a music lesson tomorrow.（明天會有一堂音樂課。）
There are going to be two tests next week.（下週將有兩次考試。）
There won’t be a show tonight.（今晚不會有表演。）

notes.title: There 的未來式：問答
notes.rule:
Will there be...? — Yes, there will. / No, there won’t.
Is / Are there going to be...? — Yes, there is / are. / No, there isn’t / aren’t.
notes.description: there 問句的簡答保留 there，不以 it 或 they 代替。will 問句的標準簡答沿用 will，be going to 問句則沿用相應的 be 動詞。
examples: Will there be a typhoon tomorrow? — No, there won’t.（明天會有颱風嗎？不會。）
Are there going to be two shows? — Yes, there are.（將有兩場表演嗎？是的。）

notes.title: 現在進行式也能表示未來安排
notes.rule: 主詞 + am / is / are + V-ing + 未來時間
notes.description: come、go、arrive、leave、move 等動詞可用現在進行式表達已安排的未來活動。要結合 tomorrow、next week 等語境判斷。go to + 地點與 be going to + 原形動詞的結構不同，例如 going to the castle 與 going to visit the castle。
examples: We are moving into a new apartment next week.（我們下週要搬進新公寓。）
My aunt is leaving for Taipei tomorrow.（我阿姨明天要出發去台北。）

notes.title: 反身代名詞的人稱與單複數
notes.rule:
I → myself；you（單數）→ yourself；he → himself；she → herself；it → itself
we → ourselves；you（複數）→ yourselves；they → themselves
notes.description: 先找反身代名詞所對應的人，再判斷人稱與單複數。you 可能是一人或多人，需看名字、boys、girls、you two 等線索。單數多以 -self 結尾，複數以 -selves 結尾。
examples: I made the pizza myself.（我親自做了披薩。）
Please help yourselves to some fruit, boys.（男孩們，請自行取用水果。）

notes.title: 主詞與受詞是同一人
notes.rule: 主詞 + 動詞 + 與主詞對應的反身代名詞
notes.description: 動作回到主詞本人時，用反身代名詞作受詞。例如 hurt herself 表示她傷到自己；hurt her 則表示傷到另一位女性。反身代名詞不能單獨代替主格當主詞。
examples: Mia hurt herself while cooking.（米雅煮飯時傷到自己。）
He taught himself to play the guitar.（他自學彈吉他。）

notes.title: 親自做與獨自做
notes.rule:
主詞 + 反身代名詞 + 動詞... / 主詞 + 動詞... + 反身代名詞
by + 反身代名詞 = 獨自；靠自己
notes.description: 反身代名詞可強調「本人親自做」，放在主詞後或句尾。by oneself 強調沒有別人幫忙；on one’s own 常有相近意思。itself 可指物，by itself 表示自行發生。
examples: The leader herself checked every order.（領導者親自檢查了每筆訂單。）
We cleaned the apartment by ourselves.（我們獨自打掃了公寓。）
The door closed by itself.（門自行關上了。）

notes.title: 反身代名詞常用表達
notes.rule:
enjoy oneself（玩得開心）
help oneself to + 食物（自行取用）
make oneself at home（像在家一樣自在）
say to oneself（心想；自言自語）
notes.description: 片語裡的反身代名詞也要依對應的人稱與單複數變化，不是每次都填 yourself。正式練習題會提供清楚的主詞或稱呼，讓你判斷形式。
examples: Did you enjoy yourself at the party, Ben?（班，你在派對玩得開心嗎？）
Make yourselves at home, children.（孩子們，別拘束，就像在自己家一樣。）

notes.title: 補充：表示人的字尾
notes.description: 有些字加上字尾會變成表示人的名詞，例如 art → artist、science → scientist、teach → teacher、work → worker、collect → collector、visit → visitor。拼字可能改變，不能對所有單字直接套用。這項作為課本補充，不混入本課 50 題文法測驗。
examples: The artist will create a new picture.（這位藝術家將創作一幅新畫。）
The visitors will arrive tomorrow.（訪客明天將抵達。）

quiz.question: The virtual music lesson will ___ interesting.
quiz.hint: will 後用原形動詞；interesting 是形容詞，前面要有 be。

quiz.question: Our company will ___ a new digital game next year.
quiz.hint: will 後接原形 create；主詞是 company 也不能把動詞加 -s。

quiz.question: I will not ___ the lyrics, so please write them down for me.
quiz.hint: will not 後仍接原形 remember，不能用第三人稱、過去式或 -ing。

quiz.question: Mia has to work all evening, so she will not ___ free tonight.
quiz.hint: free 是形容詞；will not 後須接原形 be，形成 will not be free。

quiz.question: The singer ___ perform tonight because she has lost her voice.
quiz.hint: 後面是原形 perform，否定未來式用 will not perform；不能多加 to、be 或 going。失聲也提供否定語意。

quiz.question: Dad: Will you carry this lamp for me? Ben: Yes, ___.
quiz.hint: Will you...? 的標準肯定簡答是 Yes, I will.；簡答結尾不可只用縮寫 I’ll。

quiz.question: Will your uncle ___ the order before dinner?
quiz.hint: Will + 主詞 + 原形動詞，故填 complete，不隨 uncle 加 -s。

quiz.question: Amy: Will the shop be open tomorrow? Ben: No, it ___ be open tomorrow. It's closed every Monday.
quiz.hint: 回答空格後已有原形 be，應填 won’t，形成 won’t be open；店休資訊表示否定。

quiz.question: I ___ going to learn more about modern technology this summer.
quiz.hint: be going to 的 be 要跟主詞一致；I 搭配 am。

quiz.question: My two cousins ___ going to visit our new apartment tomorrow.
quiz.hint: My two cousins 是複數主詞，因此用 are going to。

quiz.question: My little sister ___ going to learn the violin next month.
quiz.hint: My little sister 是第三人稱單數，be 動詞用 is。

quiz.question: We are going to ___ a large order for the company.
quiz.hint: be going to 後接原形動詞 complete；to 後在此不是 -ing 形式。

quiz.question: The lesson is going to ___ simple enough for beginners.
quiz.hint: simple 是形容詞，going to 後須接原形 be，形成 is going to be simple。

quiz.question: Our leader is ___ going to join us tonight; she's still in Japan.
quiz.hint: be going to 的否定把 not 放在 be 後，即 is not going to；不能用 no，也不能在 is 後加 don’t 或 doesn’t。

quiz.question: ___ your parents going to have dinner with us tomorrow?
quiz.hint: your parents 是複數；問句把 Are 放到主詞前，形成 Are your parents going to...?

quiz.question: What is the company ___ create for young children?
quiz.hint: 題目已有 is，後面又有原形 create，應組成 is going to create；is 不可直接接 will。

quiz.question: Are you going to check out the virtual museum? — Yes, I ___ going to visit it on Saturday.
quiz.hint: 回答使用 I ___ going to，須填 am，形成 I am going to；主詞從 you 轉為 I 時 be 也要改變。

quiz.question: Is Lucy going to play the guitar tonight? — No, she ___ going to play tonight. Her hand hurts.
quiz.hint: 回答中 going to 前需要 be 的否定；she 搭配 isn’t，形成 she isn’t going to。手痛說明她不表演。

quiz.question: ___ will your uncle arrive at the castle? — At ten tomorrow morning.
quiz.hint: 回答 At ten tomorrow morning 是時間，因此疑問詞用 When。

quiz.question: ___ are the students going to have dinner? — At the new restaurant.
quiz.hint: At the new restaurant 回答地點，因此用 Where 提問。

quiz.question: ___ will the visitors get to the company? — By bus.
quiz.hint: By bus 是交通方式，對應問方式的 How。

quiz.question: When ___ your brother going to leave for college?
quiz.hint: your brother 是單數，疑問詞後接 is，再接主詞與 going to。

quiz.question: What will the singer ___ after the show?
quiz.hint: 疑問詞問句仍遵守 will + 主詞 + 原形動詞，故用 do。

quiz.question: How are the workers going to ___ this heavy couch upstairs?
quiz.hint: going to 後用原形 carry；疑問詞 How 不改變這個規則。

quiz.question: There will ___ a new digital library near our school.
quiz.hint: 「將有……」用 There will be；此處不是某人擁有東西，不能用 have 或 has。

quiz.question: There ___ going to be three new songs in the show.
quiz.hint: three new songs 是複數，There be 的 going to 句型要用 are going to be。

quiz.question: There ___ going to be a large dinner at the castle.
quiz.hint: 後方 a large dinner 是單數，故用 There is going to be。

quiz.question: There is going to ___ a new lamp beside the couch.
quiz.hint: There is going to be 表示「將有」；going to 後接原形 be，不能換成 have。

quiz.question: There will not ___ any music lessons during the typhoon.
quiz.hint: 否定的「將有」是 There will not be，will not 後保留原形 be。

quiz.question: ___ there be a violin show next Sunday?
quiz.hint: 後面已有 there be，未來式問句應是 Will there be...?；Is / Are there 後不能直接再接 be。

quiz.question: Will there be any free seats tonight? — No, there ___ be any free seats. Every seat is taken.
quiz.hint: 空格後已有 be，應使用 there won’t be，表示將沒有空位；所有座位已滿也提供否定線索。

quiz.question: Are there going to be two leaders in the game? — Yes, there ___.
quiz.hint: 問句用 Are there going to be...?，肯定簡答保留 there are。

quiz.question: Our train tickets are ready. We are ___ for Taipei tomorrow.
quiz.hint: 已訂票且有 tomorrow，表示未來安排；are 後接 leaving 構成現在進行式。

quiz.question: My uncle is ___ at the station at noon tomorrow.
quiz.hint: 主詞後已有 is，表示抵達安排時用 is arriving；其他選項不能與 is 組成此句型。

quiz.question: The boxes are ready. We are ___ into the new apartment on Friday.
quiz.hint: 搬家已安排好，are moving 可表示未來計畫；are 後應接 moving，不能接 move、moves 或 to moving。

quiz.question: The singer is ___ to Kaohsiung next week to meet her fans.
quiz.hint: is coming 搭配 next week 表示未來安排；be 後用 V-ing，不用原形或第三人稱形式。

quiz.question: Nobody helped me. I made this digital card by ___.
quiz.hint: 主詞 I 對應 myself；Nobody helped me 表示獨力完成，使用 by myself。

quiz.question: Lucy cut ___ while making dinner, so she put a bandage on her own finger.
quiz.hint: Lucy 傷到自己的手指，主詞與受詞相同；單數女性用 herself。

quiz.question: The children made the hamburgers by ___. No adults helped them.
quiz.hint: The children 是第三人稱複數，對應 themselves；沒有成人協助表示獨自完成。

quiz.question: My sister and I cleaned the whole apartment by ___.
quiz.hint: My sister and I 等於 we，反身代名詞用 ourselves，不能只按 I 選 myself。

quiz.question: Ben and Tim, you must carry your own guitars by ___.
quiz.hint: 說話者同時對 Ben 和 Tim 兩人說 you，因此用複數 yourselves。

quiz.question: Anna, you are the only person here. Did you cook dinner by ___?
quiz.hint: 直接對 Anna 一人說 you，且 only person 明確是單數，應用 yourself。

quiz.question: The digital clock can turn ___ off when nobody is in the room.
quiz.hint: The digital clock 是單數物品；關掉自己時用 itself。

quiz.question: My uncle taught ___ to play the violin without a teacher.
quiz.hint: My uncle 是單數男性，自己教自己用 taught himself；without a teacher 提示自學。

quiz.question: Girls, enjoy ___ at the music show tonight!
quiz.hint: 這是對 Girls 多人說的祈使句，省略的主詞是複數 you，enjoy 後填 yourselves。

quiz.question: Tom, please help ___ to some pizza. Everyone else has already eaten.
quiz.hint: 此句直接對 Tom 一人說話；help yourself to 表示請自行取用，故用單數 yourself。

quiz.question: Welcome, Jack and Amy! Please make ___ at home.
quiz.hint: 對 Jack 和 Amy 兩位客人說話，make yourselves at home 中須用複數 yourselves。

quiz.question: Mia said to ___, "I will complete the order in time."
quiz.hint: Mia 心想或自言自語，所對應的是單數女性，say to oneself 在此用 herself。

quiz.question: The girl ___ created both the lyrics and the melody.
quiz.hint: 空格用來強調女孩「親自」創作，需用 herself；her、she、hers 都不能在此作強調語。

quiz.question: ___ will teach himself to use the new technology.
quiz.hint: 空格是句子的主詞，須用主格 He；himself 可作反身受詞，但不可單獨取代主格。

vocab.sentence: You will fail without enough practice.

phrases.sentence_chinese: 瑪莉亞獨自完成了數學作業。

phrases.sentence: My dream is to become a great dancer in the future.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 我的夢想是未來成為一名很棒的舞者。

phrases.sentence: We should learn more about AI.

phrases.sentence: If you work hard, your dream will come true.

cloze_quiz.question: Even a five-year-old can play this game. Its rules are very ___.
cloze_quiz.hint: 五歲孩子也能玩，表示規則很簡單；simple 是簡單的。

cloze_quiz.question: The art teacher asked us to ___ a new picture, not copy an old one.
cloze_quiz.hint: 不是複製舊圖，而是創作新圖；create 是創作、創造。

cloze_quiz.question: I know the tune of the song, but I cannot remember its ___.
cloze_quiz.hint: 已記得曲調，忘記的是歌曲的文字；lyrics 是歌詞。

cloze_quiz.question: There are no words in this piece of music, but its ___ is beautiful.
cloze_quiz.hint: 沒有歌詞但音樂仍好聽，指的是旋律 melody。

cloze_quiz.question: You need to connect your phone to the ___ before you can visit this website.
cloze_quiz.hint: 瀏覽網站需要網路連線；Internet 是網路。

cloze_quiz.question: Nobody touched the toy car, but it started moving by ___.
cloze_quiz.hint: toy car 是單數物品，by itself 表示自行移動。

cloze_quiz.question: You think Ben is from Japan, but he is ___ from Taiwan.
cloze_quiz.hint: 前半句是別人的想法，後半句說明事實；actually 表示其實、事實上。

cloze_quiz.question: Becoming a doctor is my biggest ___. I hope to help sick people one day.
cloze_quiz.hint: 希望有一天成為醫生，是未來的夢想 dream。

cloze_quiz.question: I do not need to borrow a computer anymore. I have my ___ now.
cloze_quiz.hint: 不必再借，表示已有自己的電腦；my own 是我自己的。

cloze_quiz.question: We wore special glasses and walked around a ___ city made by a computer.
cloze_quiz.hint: 電腦建立、透過特殊眼鏡觀看的城市是虛擬的；virtual。

cloze_quiz.question: The ___ sang three songs on stage, and everyone loved her voice.
cloze_quiz.hint: 在舞台唱歌且有好歌聲，指歌手 singer。

cloze_quiz.question: What will schools be like fifty years from now? Nobody knows the ___.
cloze_quiz.hint: fifty years from now 指五十年後，談的是未來 future。

cloze_quiz.question: This ___ clock shows the time with numbers on a screen instead of hands.
cloze_quiz.hint: 螢幕顯示數字而非指針，指數位時鐘；digital 是數位的。

cloze_quiz.question: The story is so ___ that I want to read it again right away.
cloze_quiz.hint: 讀完馬上想再讀一次，表示故事很有趣 interesting；boring 表示無聊。

cloze_quiz.question: I promise I ___ return your guitar tomorrow.
cloze_quiz.hint: promise 表示承諾，tomorrow 是未來時間；will 後接原形 return。

cloze_quiz.question: After years of hard work, her wish to open a bakery may finally ___.
cloze_quiz.hint: 多年努力後實現開麵包店的心願；come true 是成真。

cloze_quiz.question: It is six in the evening now. We are going to watch a movie at eight ___.
cloze_quiz.hint: 現在是傍晚六點，接著晚上八點看電影，指今晚 tonight。

cloze_quiz.question: My mother's brother is my ___.
cloze_quiz.hint: 媽媽的兄弟是舅舅，英文為 uncle。

cloze_quiz.question: We ordered a round ___ with cheese and tomatoes on top and cut it into slices.
cloze_quiz.hint: 圓形、上面有起司與番茄並切片食用，指披薩 pizza。

cloze_quiz.question: He put a piece of beef between the two halves of a round bun to make a ___.
cloze_quiz.hint: 把牛肉夾在圓麵包裡做成漢堡 hamburger。

cloze_quiz.question: We usually eat ___ at seven in the evening after Dad gets home.
cloze_quiz.hint: 晚上七點、爸爸回家後吃的那一餐是晚餐 dinner。

cloze_quiz.question: I have no classes or work tomorrow afternoon, so I will be ___.
cloze_quiz.hint: 沒有課也沒有工作，表示有空；free 在此指空閒的。

cloze_quiz.question: It is too dark to read. Please turn on the ___ beside the bed.
cloze_quiz.hint: 太暗無法閱讀，需要打開能照明的檯燈 lamp。

cloze_quiz.question: The musician played a six-string ___ by picking its strings with his fingers.
cloze_quiz.hint: 六條弦、用手指撥弦演奏的是吉他 guitar；其他選項非弦樂器。

cloze_quiz.question: She held the ___ under her chin and moved a bow across its four strings.
cloze_quiz.hint: 放在下巴下、有四條弦且用弓演奏的是小提琴 violin。

cloze_quiz.question: Bees make ___, a sweet food that people often add to tea.
cloze_quiz.hint: 蜜蜂製造、可以加進茶裡的甜食是蜂蜜 honey。

cloze_quiz.question: Three people can sit together on this soft ___ in the living room.
cloze_quiz.hint: 客廳裡可讓三人一起坐的柔軟家具是沙發 couch。

cloze_quiz.question: Our ___ has a kitchen, two bedrooms, and a bathroom on the sixth floor of the building.
cloze_quiz.hint: 大樓六樓裡有廚房、臥室及浴室的住家是公寓 apartment。

cloze_quiz.question: The king lived in a stone ___ with high walls and towers.
cloze_quiz.hint: 國王居住、有高牆與塔樓的石造建築是城堡 castle。

cloze_quiz.question: The ground suddenly shook during the ___, and dishes fell off the table.
cloze_quiz.hint: 地面突然搖晃、盤子掉落是地震 earthquake 的線索。

cloze_quiz.question: A ___ is a powerful storm that can bring very strong winds and heavy rain to Taiwan.
cloze_quiz.hint: 帶來強風豪雨的強烈風暴是颱風 typhoon；地震是地面震動。

cloze_quiz.question: My baby brother was ___ last night, and Mom is still resting in the hospital.
cloze_quiz.hint: 新生兒昨晚來到世上、媽媽仍在醫院休息，指出生 born。

cloze_quiz.question: New ___ makes it possible for doctors to talk to patients through computers.
cloze_quiz.hint: 讓醫生能透過電腦與病人談話的是新科技 technology。

cloze_quiz.question: After finishing high school, she plans to study medicine at ___.
cloze_quiz.hint: 高中畢業後繼續學習醫學，指上大學 college。

cloze_quiz.question: My dad works for a computer ___ that sells laptops around the world.
cloze_quiz.hint: 向全球銷售筆電、爸爸在其中工作的機構是公司 company。

cloze_quiz.question: Her first business was very ___: it earned enough money to open three more shops.
cloze_quiz.hint: 賺到能再開三家店的錢，表示事業成功 successful。

cloze_quiz.question: If you get fewer than sixty points, you will ___ the test.
cloze_quiz.hint: 分數不到及格門檻，表示考試不及格；fail 是未能通過、失敗。

cloze_quiz.question: Only one question is left. Answer it to ___ the worksheet.
cloze_quiz.hint: 只剩一題，回答後就能完成學習單；complete 是完成。

cloze_quiz.question: The customer placed an ___ for twenty computers, and we will deliver them next week.
cloze_quiz.hint: 顧客訂購二十台電腦，指一筆訂單 order。

cloze_quiz.question: As the team ___, she gives everyone a job and helps them work together.
cloze_quiz.hint: 分配工作並帶領大家合作的人是領導者 leader。

cloze_quiz.question: Your ___ beats faster when you run because it pumps blood around your body.
cloze_quiz.hint: 會跳動並將血液送往全身的器官是心臟 heart。

cloze_quiz.question: Please write down the date so you will not ___ it later.
cloze_quiz.hint: 寫下日期是為了避免之後忘記；forget 是忘記。

cloze_quiz.question: He learned a painful ___ from losing all his savings: never trust strangers with money.
cloze_quiz.hint: 因損失存款而學會不要把錢交給陌生人，是得到教訓 lesson。

cloze_quiz.question: This is a rare ___ in which a person remembers every day of her life.
cloze_quiz.hint: 描述一種罕見的情況，名詞 case 可表示案例、事例或情況。

cloze_quiz.question: Be ___ with that glass. Hold it with both hands so you do not drop it.
cloze_quiz.hint: 提醒雙手拿玻璃杯以免掉落，是要求小心 careful。

cloze_quiz.question: We were able to finish the work early ___ your help. You saved us two hours!
cloze_quiz.hint: 你的幫助讓我們提早兩小時完成，表示幸虧、由於你的幫助；thanks to。

cloze_quiz.question: The old building has become a ___ library with robots and new computer systems.
cloze_quiz.hint: 有機器人與新電腦系統的圖書館是現代化的 modern。

cloze_quiz.question: A strong wish to win can ___ a person to practice every day.
cloze_quiz.hint: 想獲勝的願望能驅使一個人天天練習；drive 在此是驅使，不是開車。

cloze_quiz.question: The twins dressed ___ without any help from their parents.
cloze_quiz.hint: The twins 是兩個人，自己穿衣服用複數反身代名詞 themselves。

cloze_quiz.question: The books children read can ___ the way they think about the world.
cloze_quiz.hint: 書會影響、形塑孩子看待世界的方式；shape 在此是動詞。
